theta_e.method: half the separation of the arc and the counter-image candidate

system.description: The green arrow marks the deflector nucleus of an inclined early-type galaxy. The cyan arrow points to a curved arc hugging the north-western side of the deflector at about 2"; the magenta arrow marks a compact counter-image candidate on the opposite, south-western side. The arc is tangentially stretched about the nucleus. Two dotted circles flag the stars bracketing the system and dashed circles the field galaxies to mask.
